text:
Anya: Quick heads-up — the launch dashboard shows a sharp drop in MQLs for the webinar cohort yesterday around 11:00 PST. 42 -> 19. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Mike: Yep, I see the dip. Pulling raw funnel now.
Jordan: Could be related to the GA4 tag change we pushed at 10:45.
Sophia: Email creative and landing unchanged from our side. Send was on time but subject test variant A had lower open rate.
Mike: raw query snippet:
```
select event_time, count(distinct lead_id) as mqls
from attribution_events
where event_date = '2026-03-22' and funnel_stage = 'mql'
group by event_time
order by event_time;
```
Mike: results show a cluster drop in the 11:00-11:30 window, and ~19 leads with empty utm_campaign.
MetricsBot: Automated report uploaded: /files/weekly_kpis_2026-03-22.csv (attached). :file_folder:
Anya: @Mike can you confirm the 19 were missing campaign tag vs misrouted team? We need to know if dashboard attribution or actual lead loss.
Mike: 18/19 had utm_campaign = '' and utm_source='email' — so likely tagging loss, not dropped conversions.
Jordan: That aligns with GA4 mapping tweak. I can revert the mapping, but that'll affect GA4 continuity.
Sophia: Can we patch mapping to fallback to `email_campaign` instead of full revert? Less disruptive.
Mike: Suggest SQL patch for backfill and mapping fallback:
```
-- mapping fallback
update lead_attribution set campaign = coalesce(utm_campaign, email_campaign)
where event_date >= '2026-03-22' and campaign = '';
-- backfill counts for dashboard
refresh materialized view mv_weekly_mqls;
```
Anya: If we backfill, we need final numbers for the weekly KPI deck. How long to refresh?
Mike: Backfill and MV refresh started, should finish in ~5 minutes. Will post final delta.
MetricsBot: Dashboard refresh complete — mv_weekly_mqls updated, +21 MQLs reattributed to webinar cohort. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Sophia: Great, thanks team. I'll note attribution fix in the postmortem and update the launch recap doc.
Jordan: I'll follow up on GA4 mapping change to avoid future holes.
Anya: Thanks all. Adding a quick action: 1) add fallback to mapping, 2) add test for utm presence in nightly checks, 3) update KPI slide with reattributed numbers. :memo: 
Mike: noted and added to tracking board. :white_check_mark: 
Sophia: closing loop on copy changes in the deck now.
Anya: closing thread once slide updated. :thumbsup:
